description: The chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, labeled with different language families in a specific order, although the exact labels are not visible. The vertical axis is labeled with a value representing the effect of context masking, with a linear scale ranging from approximately -0.1 to 0.4, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Each bar corresponds to a language family, with a distinct color, and is accompanied by an error bar indicating the standard deviation. The bars vary in height, with some having values around 0.0, while others reach up to approximately 0.35. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on particular bars.
